savage_attacks.name: Savage Attacks
savage_attacks.description: When you score a critical hit with a melee weapon attack, you can roll one of the weapon's damage dice one additional time and add it to the extra damage of the critical hit.
savage_attacks.effect: On a critical hit with a melee weapon: roll one additional weapon damage die and add it to the crit damage.

great_weapon_master.name: Great Weapon Master
great_weapon_master.description: You've learned to put the weight of a weapon to your advantage. Before you make a melee attack with a heavy weapon you are proficient with, you can choose to take a -5 penalty to the attack roll to gain +10 damage.
great_weapon_master.effect: Optional on melee attacks with heavy weapons: -5 to hit, +10 to damage.
